messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hello

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: What number of screenshots do you require?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: There will be an additional $20 charge for the feature graph.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hi, I have 6 phone screenshots; can you make the total 8? An extra 20 for the android graphic also works for me.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes, could we change the hourly payment to a fixed-project fee?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For 8 iOS screenshots, the price will be $130, with another $20 for the feature graph. The contract will be $150 only.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: That price is too high, my friend. I had the android screenshots done for $80. I can offer 100 total, including the android graphic.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay Sir. I’ll deliver for iOS only, not iPad. Please confirm first, then send the contract.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yes, not iPad. Okay, I’m sending it now.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: okay great

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I’m beginning the work now. Thanks.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Great! If you have any questions, just let me know.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001], please swap the image I’m attaching here with 02-ai-skipping.png above, as it is an updated version.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay Sir.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],
Thank you for continuing to collaborate with us! Here’s a brief note about the next steps: after the first draft is delivered, we set aside one business day to review and apply your feedback. As soon as you provide final approval for this draft, I’ll proceed immediately with the Feature Graph.

I look forward to hearing your thoughts!
Best,
[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Thanks, [FREELANCER_NAME_001]! Overall, it looks great. Please address these comments:
1. The first image looks good, but the facial expressions appear upset/sad. Please adjust them to something more appropriate.
2. Please remove the violence pill at the top while retaining nudity, kissing and profanity. The top photo also depicts active kissing; please either hide it or replace it with an image that implies kissing without actually showing it.
3, 4, 5: These look good.
6. Could you replace this with something showing that it can be watched on any Google TV device?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hi, thank you for the feedback! I’ve noted all the requested changes above and will share the revised screenshots soon.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please review the revised screenshots. I’m now moving ahead with the Feature Graph for Play Store (1024x500).

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Check for the feature graph.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Thank you, [FREELANCER_NAME_002] screenshots look excellent. For the graphic, please make these changes:
- Place the phrase "Control What You See" below the logo.
- Update the bottom text to "AI-powered protection for every family member"

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Okay Sir

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please check it now and let me know whether any changes are needed. If everything looks fine, we can move forward with delivery.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thanks [FREELANCER_NAME_001], it looks great. One final comment: please center the Skipifi logo above "Control What You See", and then proceed with delivery.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Here is the zip file with the ready-to-upload PNGs. I’m also preparing the Figma file and will send it to you after a few hours.

Please approve the milestone.
Thanks

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Here is the Figma File.

What do you think of my work? If possible, 5-star feedback would help me remain successful and top rated. I’m always available for you here.
Thanks.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thank you, [FREELANCER_NAME_003] looks excellent, and I really appreciate how responsive you’ve been!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Great, could you please take a moment to end the contract?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I would also appreciate 5 stars, since 5 stars help me stay successful and top rated on Upwork.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],  
I hope the final delivery of the Skipifi Screenshots matches your expectations. If you want the Android screenshots updated with the same design, I'll do it for $30 only.
If everything looks good, I’ll close the contract.  
I’ll also remain available until Aug 14th to help with any bugs, minor tweaks, or questions.  

Thank you.
